verses.text: The word of the LORD which came to Zephani'ah the son of Cu'shi, son of Gedali'ah, son of Amari'ah, son of Hezeki'ah, in the days of Josi'ah the son of A'mon, king of Judah.
“I will utterly sweep away everything
“I will sweep away man and beast;
“I will stretch out my hand against Judah,
those who bow down on the roofs
those who have turned back from following the LORD,
Be silent before the Lord GOD!
And on the day of the LORD’s sacrifice—
On that day I will punish
“On that day,” says the LORD,
Wail, O inhabitants of the Mortar!
At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps,
Their goods shall be plundered,
The great day of the LORD is near,
A day of wrath is that day,
a day of trumpet blast and battle cry
I will bring distress on men,
Neither their silver nor their gold
Come together and hold assembly,
before you are driven away
Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land,
For Gaza shall be deserted,
Woe to you inhabitants of the seacoast,
And you, O seacoast, shall be pastures,
The seacoast shall become the possession
“I have heard the taunts of Moab
Therefore, as I live,” says the LORD of hosts,
This shall be their lot in return for their pride,
The LORD will be terrifying against them;
You also, O Ethiopians,
And he will stretch out his hand against the north,
Herds shall lie down in the midst of her,
This is the exultant city
Woe to her that is rebellious and defiled,
She listens to no voice,
Her officials within her
Her prophets are wanton,
The LORD within her is righteous,
“I have cut off nations;
I said, ‘Surely she will fear me,
“Therefore wait for me,” says the LORD,
“Yes, at that time I will change the speech of the peoples
From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia
“On that day you shall not be put to shame
For I will leave in the midst of you
those who are left in Israel;
Sing aloud, O daughter of Zion;
The LORD has taken away the judgments against you,
On that day it shall be said to Jerusalem:
The LORD, your God, is in your midst,
as on a day of festival.
Behold, at that time I will deal
At that time I will bring you home,
